mobbin:2b3f4914-5fd3-49bc-8f83-32b7fcab6.summary: From Home, the user opens Live Notes on a LIVE banner, sees AI Notes still writing plus AskFred shortcuts, then works a live Transcript with 'REC' and assists.
steps: Home LIVE banner with Live Notes and Stop
AI Notes writing with Catch me up
Live Assist with REC, transcript, assists
steal: A global LIVE banner shows session title, start time, 'Live Notes' and 'Stop' (screen 1), so recording is visible outside the player.
AI Notes say 'writing notes… points will appear here automatically' (screen 2) while speech-to-text works.
'Catch me up (Last 1 min)' and related assists (screens 2-3) help faculty re-enter without jumping through the video.
A live transcript shows speaker initials, clickable times and 'Scroll to bottom' (screen 3), like SRV Transcript during recording.
avoid: Deal-centric AskFred prompts such as 'Ask anything across your deal' (screens 2-3) frame the wrong domain for clinical sim, so keep assists clinical and scenario-focused.
mobbin:2b3f4914-5fd3-49bc-8f83-32b7fcab6.fit: Recording: would add live Annotation and Transcript to the SRV and a Center Overview LIVE strip, with AI markers during the session and Catch-me-up for faculty who stepped away.

mobbin:f1e15c44-a1fc-4eee-8644-7320cbca5.summary: In post-meeting review, the user selects a transcript span, bookmarks it so a star appears on the timeline, with AI summary and notes linking to the same times.
steps: Review with AI notes and transcript selection
Bookmarked span with pink highlight and star
steal: Selecting transcript text bookmarks it (screens 1-2), so Annotation can come from the Transcript tab, not only the marker track.
A star on the progress bar marks the bookmarked moment (screen 2), so one clear pin reduces marker collision risk.
AI Notes bullets have blue jump times (screens 1-2), so summary and seek work like SRV chapters.
mobbin:f1e15c44-a1fc-4eee-8644-7320cbca5.fit: Recording: would extend SRV Transcript so selecting text pins a single timeline star and Annotation entry instead of stacking more overlapping speech-bubble markers.
